name: developer-os
description: Local-first workflows and an Obsidian-compatible Brain for Claude Code and Codex

scripts.test: npm run test:bootstrap && npm run test:suite && npm run test:lifecycle && npm run test:update-recovery
scripts.test:bootstrap: vitest run apps/cli/src/bootstrap/executor.test.ts -t 'publishes a complete V2 handoff and permanently retains its exact plan and two slots' && vitest run apps/cli/src/bootstrap/executor.test.ts -t '^(?!.*publishes a complete V2 handoff and permanently retains its exact plan and two slots).*$'
scripts.test:bootstrap:main: vitest run apps/cli/src/bootstrap/executor.test.ts -t 'publishes a complete V2 handoff and permanently retains its exact plan and two slots' && vitest run apps/cli/src/bootstrap/executor.test.ts -t '^(?!.*(publishes a complete V2 handoff and permanently retains its exact plan and two slots|fine-grained death)).*$'
scripts.test:update-recovery: vitest run tests/integration/update/recovery.test.ts -t '^(?!.*(at every death point|died anywhere in that update)).*$'
scripts.test:update-recovery:deaths: vitest run tests/integration/update/recovery.test.ts -t '^(?!.*(at every death point|died anywhere in that update)).*(death|died).*$'
scripts.test:update-recovery:rest: vitest run tests/integration/update/recovery.test.ts -t '^(?!.*(at every death point|died anywhere in that update|death|died)).*$'
scripts.test:update-recovery:sweeps: vitest run tests/integration/update/recovery.test.ts -t 'at every death point|died anywhere in that update'
scripts.test:lifecycle:uninstall: vitest run lifecycle/uninstall.v2.test.ts lifecycle/uninstall-recovery.v2.test.ts lifecycle/uninstall-detach.v2.test.ts lifecycle/uninstall-launchd.v2.test.ts
scripts.test:lifecycle:core: vitest run lifecycle/absent-manifest-uninstall.v2.test.ts lifecycle/manifest-anchor.v2.test.ts lifecycle/mutation-gate.v2.test.ts lifecycle/manifest-rewrite.v2.test.ts lifecycle/mutation-gate-update.v2.test.ts lifecycle/admission.v2.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:vendor-ingest && pnpm --pm-on-fail=ignore build && git diff --check
